title: The Nine Secrets Appear
summary: As Li Ruoyu meditates and Clumsy Peak's inheritance stirs, the Bodhi Stone pulls Ye Fan into a Dao Rune world where he must defeat a perfect copy of himself, and by 'surpassing himself' he comprehends the Jie Secret, one of the Nine Secrets, which can multiply power up to tenfold but is hard to trigger. Li Ruoyu reveals he knows Ye Fan has the Ancient Desolate Sacred Body and promises to keep it secret. Ye Fan agrees to belong to Clumsy Peak but says he must first find a missing friend and the Domain Gate; Li Ruoyu lets him leave whenever he likes but forbids him to teach the secret to anyone, including Ziyue. Elder Xu brings hopefuls from the main peaks now that the inheritance has revived, and Li Ruoyu gives them half a month to comprehend something at the peak. Ziyue, calling herself Clumsy Peak's senior disciple, tries to wheedle the secret out of him, offers to help him win back 'that beauty', and threatens to expose the Demon Emperor's Sacred Heart, the Mother Qi of All Things and the Green Copper. Li Xiaoman then arrives to warn him to leave Taixuan because Star Peak is looking into him, but he refuses to go yet.
events: The Bodhi Stone draws Ye Fan into a Dao Rune world at Clumsy Peak
